title: Projection-normalized completed coefficient transport and finite pullback evaluation interfaces
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a morphism of schemes $g:X\to Y$ with the adic datum $d=(\mathcal O_E,(\varpi_E))$. The canonical interface consists of the projection-normalized coefficient maps
$\operatorname{quotientEquiv}_{\ell,E,n}$, $\operatorname{finiteRingIso}_{\ell,E,T,n}$, and
$\operatorname{completedRingIso}_{\ell,E,T}$, together with the induced coefficient transport
$\operatorname{transport}_{\ell,E,T}$, as defined in [lem-sf-immersion-completed-pullback-comparison]. For the completed reduction tower of $d$ along $g$, it also consists of the canonical pure-tensor generator
$\operatorname{completedReductionFiniteGenerator}_{g,d,n}$, the K-flat representative map
$\operatorname{completedReductionFiniteModelMap}_{g,d,n}$, the derived-limit projection
$\operatorname{completedReductionLimitProjection}_{d,X,n}$, and the normalized finite evaluation isomorphism
$\operatorname{completedReductionFiniteEvaluation}_{g,d,n}$, as defined in [lemma-weil-pbc-completed-pullback-reduction]. These are the fixed coefficient transport and finite-level comparison maps used by subsequent completed-pullback statements; no new choices or arbitrary isomorphisms are introduced.
